decision.reason: No existing project-owned runtime path can produce an authoritative mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 row from MWORKS_live_downlink/MWORKS, ROS2_runtime_echo/ROS2, or MWORKS_ROS2_live_downlink/MWORKS_ROS2 and match it to a pending mosim.ue_command.v1 request in UE runtime. Existing UE source provides a sender-only mosim.ue_command.v1 uplink, a source-static command echo receiver shell, and source/static reducer guards; the runtime socket/listener/downlink producer remains unimplemented or out of scope.

source_anchor_summary.command_sender: UE5/Bridge/Source/QuadrotorMworksBridge/Private/QuadrotorMworksUdpCommandSenderComponent.cpp is sender-only; Result.bSent is explicitly not command ack.
source_anchor_summary.command_echo_receiver_shell: UE5/Bridge/Source/QuadrotorMworksBridge/Private/QuadrotorMworksExperimentConsoleCommandEchoReceiverComponent.cpp validates mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 JSON and forwards it to the state component, but has no runtime socket/listener/timer/background receive loop.
source_anchor_summary.state_component: UE5/Bridge/Source/QuadrotorMworksBridge/Private/QuadrotorMworksExperimentConsoleStateComponent.cpp records pending requests and applies echo JSON only after schema, source/authority, timestamp, identity, no-pose-overwrite, and matching-pending checks.
source_anchor_summary.frame_receiver: UE5/Bridge/Source/QuadrotorMworksBridge/Private/QuadrotorMworksUdpReceiverComponent.cpp remains a quadrotor.unreal_state frame/status receiver and must not be treated as command echo ack.

future_minimum_live_probe_gate: A UE runtime/editor session records one pending mosim.ue_command.v1 request by run_id, request_id, seq, time_s, and command kind.

A task-authorized live producer/downlink emits one mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 row with source/ack_authority from MWORKS_live_downlink/MWORKS, ROS2_runtime_echo/ROS2, or MWORKS_ROS2_live_downlink/MWORKS_ROS2.
The echo row includes time_s, accepted or rejected status, no_pose_overwrite_status=pass, and matching command identity.
The consumer sink UQuadrotorMworksExperimentConsoleStateComponent.ApplyCommandEchoJson updates accepted/rejected state only for the matching pending request.
The probe captures command packet, pending state, echo packet, UE log/evidence, negative false-ack checks, exit/cleanup state, and runs only once.
